verdict.rationale: The CLI is distributed from a public GitHub repo and runs on the user's own machine under a Node runtime, so the client side can be run locally. However, it depends on Google sign-in and Google-hosted Gemini models, with no evidence of running the model backend yourself or using local models. Missing for 10: self-hostable model/backend or local-model support, explicit open-source license and self-hosting docs, independent corroboration of a fully self-hosted setup.
